note: F1.11 benchmark requests, written 2026-11-08 AFTER the thresholds of f1_11_criteria.md were approved and committed (04efa5c, amendment c57b54f) and BEFORE any F1.11 run. Distinct from the F1.1 bench (f1_1_prompts.json). Each conversation starts in a fresh session and workspace; 'turns' are sent in order; 'fallback' (at most 2, in order) is sent only when the previous turn ended WITHOUT a proposal and the conversation has an expected plan. Confirmation is never given by the harness except where a turn is literally 'RUN' (the interface's Run button). Scoring rules: f1_11_criteria.md, section 'Requests and scoring'.
